name: Continental Simos PCR2.1, VW 1.6 TDI CR (identification only)

sources: own live UDS identification of a VW 1.6 TDI CR engine ECU (DIDs 0xF191 / 0xF197) through OpenTune's elm327obd driver, 2026-11-18. 'vehicle-tested' here covers ONLY that live identity read (the identity keys and the UDS addressing); there is no flash image, layout, map, checksum or seed/key data in this definition
public parts/repair listings cross-referencing 03L907425C to Simos PCR2.1 (family attribution MEDIUM, see notes)

notes: IDENTIFICATION ONLY - the 'vehicle-tested' evidence covers the live identity read and nothing else. Identified live via elm327obd 2026-11-18; no image read. A VW Passat B7 1.6 TDI common-rail (EA189) engine ECU answered UDS ReadDataByIdentifier on HS-CAN 7E0/7E8 with ECU name (DID 0xF197) 'R4 1.6l TDI' and hardware/part number (DID 0xF191) '03L907425C'. This definition carries identity keys and addressing only: no flash layout, no regions, no maps, no checksum or seed/key claim (checksum and seedkey are null, flash_size is unset). Family attribution is from PUBLIC parts/repair listings, evidence level MEDIUM: they cross-reference 03L907425C to the Continental/Siemens-VDO number 5WP42902AA and list it as a Simos PCR2.1 unit for VAG 1.6 TDI CR (e.g. CAYC/CAYD); no public source found ties 03L907425* to Bosch EDC17C46 (EDC17C46 listings carry 03L907309* hardware numbers). Not yet confirmed from this unit's own flash. If a full read confirms PCR2.1, start from the family definition siemens-pcr21 (checksum pcr21) and confirm per software version before any write. The ECU name 'R4 1.6l TDI' is recorded here only and is deliberately NOT a match key: VAG uses it for 1.6 TDI engine ECUs from both suppliers. (Renamed in 0.8: the id was 'siemens-pcr21-03l907425c'.)
